products.title: SetScout: Never Overpay for LEGO Again
products.description: A LEGO price tracker that watches 90+ retailers all day, alerts you when a set you want drops, and ranks the whole catalogue for people buying to hold.

products.title: Ghost Runner: Race Your Last Run
products.description: An iPhone and Apple Watch app that turns your Apple Health runs into routes, so you can race the ghost of your best time live on your wrist.
